items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Ralph called me before I came out here and asked who I wanted to play with

ctx.x: Well when you get that schedule, when you get here, it must be interesting to look and see — who am I going to play with this year.
Yeah. Ralph called me before I came out here and asked who I wanted to play with, and I said anybody, man, makes no difference. All you guys are great. I don’t care.
Did you ever get in a situation in any of these parties where someone calls a tune and you don’t really know. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
